# OverCue Desktop 2.2.22 for Windows

- Choose your DJM-A9 mods before patching: Stems EQ, six simultaneous Sound Color FX, and the Beat FX values option can be selected independently.
- Toggle up to six Sound Color FX together using the mixer’s effect buttons, with shared COLOR and PARAMETER controls.
- Add SKIP 1/3 & 2/3 at the bottom of the A9 UTILITY / MY SETTINGS menu for Echo, Delay, Ping Pong and Spiral. The option starts OFF after each power-on.
- Build each selection locally from your official A9 1.22 update. Unchecked mods keep their factory behavior, and your original update stays unchanged.
